{{Quote|I will not harm you. You are in Mahara Kesh, the Temple of Healing. My name is Calleh, a healer.|Calleh, to Xesh|<ref name="DOTJ 5">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 5|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 5]]</ref>}}
'''Mahara Kesh,''' the '''Temple of Healing''', was one of the nine [[Je'daii Temples]] established by the [[Je'daii Order]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. Constructed between [[36,453 BBY]] and [[36,019 BBY]], Mahara Kesh was built in the [[Deep Ocean]] around the [[Tho Yor]] pyramid [[Starship/Legends|ship]] that had brought the first [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] pilgrims to the [[Ocean/Legends|sea]]. The Je'daii who studied at Mahara Kesh focused on the healing arts, and [[Je'daii Journeyer]]s&mdash;young Je'daii who were completing their [[Great Journey]] across Tython to visit each of the temples&mdash;learned about healing both with and without [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] there. During the conflict in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[25,805 BBY]] known as the [[Despot War]], [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] were installed on the temple as defensive measures, and by [[25,793 BBY]] the mated [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] couple of [[Naro]] and [[Calleh]] were serving as the [[Je'daii Temple Master|Temple Masters]] of Mahara Kesh.

==Description==
[[File:Mahara_Kesh_Temple.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Mahara Kesh]]
A floating structure in the middle of the [[Deep Ocean]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], Mahara Kesh was constructed around the [[Tho Yor]] pyramid [[Starship/Legends|ship]] that had brought the first pilgrims to the Deep [[Ocean/Legends|Ocean]]. A rectangular stone island with smooth, steep walls was built around the Tho Yor, with triangular extensions jutting out from each corner that hosted [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. The portion of the temple above that base consisted of several flat platforms that formed a [[Color/Legends|gray-green]] step pyramid structure, and the tip of the Tho Yor that jutted above the pyramid was topped with a blue crystalline tower.<ref name="DOTJ 0" />

Eight smaller pyramids with their own blue towers ringed the Tho Yor, and portions of Mahara Kesh also extended [[Water/Legends|underwater]].<ref name="DOTJ 0" /> A number of towers jutted down from the underside of the temple, with a central prong that was larger than the others. The interior of the temple was filled with advanced medical facilities and chambers, as well as various [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]] rooms. Many of the rooms that lined the exterior of the temple had wide [[Window/Legends|windows]] that allowed their occupants to gaze out into the depths of the Deep Ocean.<ref name="DOTJ 5" />

==History==
{{Quote|What is a&hellip; healer? Will you kill me now?''"<br />"''No, child.|Calleh and Xesh|<ref name="DOTJ 5" />}}
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[36,453 BBY]], the [[Tho Yor Arrival]] occurred&mdash;the eight Tho Yor pyramid starships brought [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] philosophers, warriors, [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]], artists, and scholars of many [[Species/Legends|species]] from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to the planet Tython and scattered the pilgrims across the surface. One of the Tho Yor traveled to the Deep Ocean, where it sank partially into the ocean and floated there. By the year [[36,019 BBY]], Mahara Kesh&mdash;the Temple of Healing&mdash;had been constructed around the Tho Yor by the [[Je'daii Order]], as the pilgrims called themselves, and it was one of the nine [[Je'daii Temples]] that had been constructed around or near the eight other Tho Yor. By that [[Time/Legends|time]], the Je'daii had established the tradition of the [[Great Journey]], which saw young Je'daii known as [[Je'daii Journeyer]]s travel the surface of Tython and visit each temple.<ref name="Into the Void" /> Mahara Kesh's inhabitants focused their studies on the healing arts, learning and teaching both [[Force healing/Legends|healing]] through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and healing without it.<ref name="DOTJ 0" />

[[File:Mahara_Kesh_facilities.png|thumb|right|240px|Some of the facilities at Mahara Kesh]]
During the [[Despot War]], a conflict that erupted in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] in [[25,805 BBY]], laser cannons were installed on Mahara Kesh to protect the temple.<ref name="DOTJ 0" /> In [[25,802 BBY]], the Je'daii Journeyer [[Lanoree Brock]] visited Mahara Kesh on her Great Journey sometime after her brother [[Dalien Brock]] disappeared while the two were studying at [[Anil Kesh]], the Temple of Science.<ref name="Into the Void" /> By the year [[25,793 BBY]], the mated [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] couple [[Calleh]] and [[Naro]] were serving jointly as Mahara Kesh's [[Je'daii Temple Master|Temple Masters]], and Anil Kesh's Temple Master [[Quan-Jang]] was brought to Mahara Kesh along with the Force-sensitive off-worlder [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] and several other Je'daii who had helped capture Xesh. Mahara Kesh's healers set to work tending to the wounded. Ten [[Standard day/Legends|days]] after Xesh and the others were brought to the temple, the [[Je'daii Council]] decided to [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] Xesh to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Bogan]] so that he could bring himself back into balance, and despite the protests of the Journeyers who had helped capture him, [[Je'daii Ranger]]s [[Rori Fenn]] and [[Hawk Ryo]] took Xesh from Mahara Kesh to Bogan in their [[Peacemaker-class cruiser|''Peacemaker''-class cruiser]].<ref name="DOTJ 5" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mahara Kesh was first pictured in the [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|preview issue 0]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which was written by [[John Ostrander]], penciled by [[Jan Duursema]],<ref name="DOTJ 0" /> and published on [[February 1]], [[2012]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/20-342/Star-Wars-Dawn-of-the-Jedi-0|text=Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi #0}}</ref> It first appeared in the series' [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|fifth issue]], also written by Ostrander, penciled by Duursema,<ref name="DOTJ 5" /> and released on [[June 20]] of the same year.<ref name="Dark Horse2">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/18-031/Star-Wars-Dawn-of-the-Jedi-Force-Storm-5|text=Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi—Force Storm #5}}</ref>
